multilevel.gradient_budget_scope: fixed after initial L-only calibration using mean old-pair gradient norms; no current-batch adaptation
multilevel.aux_ce_routing: both heads fit by detached clean A/B features; no auxiliary CE to backbone

multilevel.style_scope: extra L main identity CE at selected hooks; same TX/day, cross RX, different real PID; duplicate occurrences permitted

rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read

rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup
